name: session-info
description: A row above the prompt naming the model and effort, the project, and the git branch with its unsaved changes and its distance from the upstream.

refreshSeconds.title: Recheck git every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the row rereads git between turns, to catch a branch switch or an edit made outside the session. 0 rechecks only after turns and shell commands.

maxFiles.title: Changed files listed
maxFiles.description: How many changed files the expanded row lists before it says how many more there are.
